_help: Copy this file to settings.json and edit that copy; settings.json is git-ignored, so updates never overwrite it. Every key is optional: delete one to use the built-in default, which the monitor names at startup.

cache._persist_to_file_help: Set false to keep news, report, and 4chan baselines only until this process exits.

sound._wav_path_help: Set wav_path to null to use the normal Windows alert sound.

reports._ignore_help: Each LINE of a report is matched against the patterns below. A line that matches is left out of the alert; a report whose every line matches raises no alert at all. Matching ignores case and looks anywhere in the line; % stands for any run of characters. A pattern starting with # is switched off: delete the # to switch it on.
ignore: # You have created the military force %.
# Your relationship with the % due to your %
# Your relationship with the % can't get any %
# Your population's satisfaction has % due to your %
# Your population can't be any more satisfied,
# As you have more than % siphoned off.
reports._completions_help: Every finished action reports '<action name> completed successfully.', using the action's own name - and only 38 of the game's 62 actions are named 'Build ...'. The others start with Upgrade, Dig, Plow, Ship, Smuggle, Manufacture, Distribute, Burn, Drug or Receive. So '% completed successfully.' silences every completion in one line; uncomment the verb-specific ones instead if you want to silence your building work but still hear about, say, shipments to the Empires.
reports._tick_help: The block from 'Show Details' down is the two-hourly tick: its wrapper, production and consumption, the relation and satisfaction effects, the caps, the upkeep bills and the siphons. Switch that block on and a quiet tick goes silent, while a tick that lost you a force, starved a factory or damaged the environment still alerts - with just that line, because the lines are judged one at a time. Every one of these is routine bookkeeping; nothing that reports something happening TO you is listed here, so an unedited file cannot hide a warning.
reports._sold_help: There is deliberately no pattern for 'You sold % % to % and made % bits.'. That one fires when somebody else buys from your standing sell order, which is news rather than bookkeeping - the same reason 'You received % % as part of your deal.' and 'Your deal with % was accepted.' are absent.

market._goods_help: A good whose key starts with # is switched off: delete the # to watch that good's buyer's market, and the monitor will alert every poll while a matching order is pending.
market._overrides_help: friends alerts on buyers on your friends list (blue in game); alliance alerts on buyers in your alliance (green in game); a buyer who is both satisfies either. always and never override both. IMPORTANT: they match the NATION name exactly as it appears in the Buyer column of the marketplace, NOT the player's username - the two are unrelated in this game, so a player called Lacera Viscera may play a nation called Fish Bucket, and you must write the nation. Matching works like reports.ignore: case-insensitive, anywhere in the name, % standing for any run of characters. never beats always, and always beats both friends and alliance. An always or never entry starting with # is switched off too. Note friends and alliance cover every nation a player owns, while always and never name one nation each.

fourchan._thread_url_help: Set thread_url to a thread you want watched, for example https://boards.4chan.org/mlp/thread/43454282/clop-financial-crisis-edition. Leave it null to disable thread monitoring; threads archive, so a URL left here goes stale.
